name: Ceesalo

tenures.role: wrestler — founding World Champion; later ran interference for a fellow wrestler
tenures.source: the fed's own served "Super September" Pay Per View recap (promotions/bswf/archive/super-september.html); a run-in save on the fed's own served Thursday Night Thump-Fest broadcast (promotions/bswf/archive/thursday-night-thump.html)

caption: Won the six-man "Super September" tournament final over Nick Hart, becoming the BSWF World Championship's own founding titleholder in the held record; later ran in alongside Castro to break up a Made Men beatdown at Thursday Night Thump-Fest.

name: Merchandi$e

tenures.role: wrestler — World Champion (won the belt from The Clark); one half of the Made Men, the reigning BSWF Tag Team Champions
tenures.source: the fed's own served Rankings page (promotions/bswf/archive/rankings.html); the fed's own served Monday Mayhem broadcast, where he defeats The Clark for the BSWF World Championship (promotions/bswf/archive/monday-mayhem.html); the fed's own served Thursday Night Thump-Fest broadcast, where he and Mi$ta defend the BSWF Tag Team Championship as the Made Men (promotions/bswf/archive/thursday-night-thump.html)

caption: Won the BSWF World Championship from The Clark at Monday Mayhem with Wrestletech's own interference turning the match, the title's own last-attested holder in the held record and one half of the Made Men, the reigning BSWF Tag Team Champions.

name: Debo

tenures.role: wrestler — Super September semifinalist; the BSWF World Championship's own #1 contender per the fed's own Rankings page
tenures.source: the fed's own served "Super September" Pay Per View recap; the fed's own served Rankings page (Debo named #1 contender); the fed's own served Monday Mayhem and Thursday Night Thump-Fest broadcasts

caption: Beat the Proprietor of Pain in the "Super September" tournament before falling to Nick Hart, interfering later in the final to help Ceesalo win, then closed out Thursday Night Thump-Fest by chokeslamming Merchandi$e and carrying off the physical BSWF World Championship belt.

name: Proprietor of Pain

tenures.source: the fed's own served "Super September" Pay Per View recap — first-round loss to Debo

caption: Lost the first round of the "Super September" tournament to Debo, chair-shotted and chokeslammed before the bell even finished ringing.

name: MC New York

tenures.source: the fed's own served "Super September" Pay Per View recap — first-round loss to Nick Hart

caption: Lost the first round of the "Super September" tournament to Nick Hart, tapping out to the Hartbreaker after a near-miss top-rope elbow.

name: Nick Hart

tenures.role: wrestler — Super September runner-up; BSWF Tag Team Championship's own #1 contender (with Debo) per the fed's own Rankings page
tenures.source: the fed's own served "Super September" Pay Per View recap; the fed's own served Rankings page; the fed's own served Monday Mayhem and Thursday Night Thump-Fest broadcasts

caption: Beat MC New York and Debo to reach the "Super September" tournament final, where Debo's own interference cost him the BSWF World Championship against Ceesalo — wrestling hurt with a broken leg by Monday Mayhem, he crutch-drilled Mi$ta at Thursday Night Thump-Fest to help Debo save The Clark from a Made Men beatdown.

name: The Great Mysterious

tenures.source: the fed's own served "Super September" Pay Per View recap — first-round loss to Ceesalo

caption: A masked entrant who dropped from the rafters to ambush Ceesalo at the "Super September" tournament's own opening bell, then lost the first round anyway.

name: DuGaul

tenures.source: the fed's own served "Super September" Pay Per View recap — beat Blakk in round one, lost to Ceesalo in the semifinal

caption: Beat Blakk in the first round of the "Super September" tournament before losing a hard-fought semifinal to Ceesalo, who reversed a figure-four late and finished with the Ceesalo-down.

name: Blakk

tenures.source: the fed's own served "Super September" Pay Per View recap — first-round loss to DuGaul

caption: Billed as a newcomer for the "Super September" tournament, lost the first round to DuGaul's conquistadore bulldog.

name: The Clark

tenures.role: wrestler — BSWF World Champion (lost the belt to Merchandi$e)
tenures.source: the fed's own served Monday Mayhem broadcast, where he loses the BSWF World Championship to Merchandi$e; the fed's own served Thursday Night Thump-Fest broadcast, where he challenges the Made Men and is beaten down

identity.note: No relation asserted to any 'Clark' outside this promotion; the decorated-name guard flagged this bare-name mint against the unrelated CSWA unit "The Clark Brothers" — different entity, different type, different promotion, no shared evidence.

caption: Held the BSWF World Championship into Monday Mayhem, where Wrestletech's own interference cost him the belt against Merchandi$e, then challenged the Made Men at Thursday Night Thump-Fest with a mystery partner who never showed and was beaten down until Debo and Nick Hart ran in to save him.

name: Mi$ta

tenures.role: wrestler — one half of the Made Men, the BSWF Tag Team Champions
tenures.source: the fed's own served Rankings page (ranked #5); the fed's own served Monday Mayhem and Thursday Night Thump-Fest broadcasts

caption: One half of the Made Men alongside Merchandi$e, defending the BSWF Tag Team Championship against Kadafi and Scarface at Thursday Night Thump-Fest in a match the referee never got to finish.

name: Wrestletech

identity.note: No relation asserted outside this promotion; the decorated-name guard flagged this bare-surname aka against the unrelated RSPWF character "Superstar" Stephanie Harper — different entity, different promotion, no shared evidence.

tenures.source: the fed's own served Rankings page (ranked #2); the fed's own served Monday Mayhem broadcast, which names him "Wrestletech" in its own header and calls him "Harper" throughout its own recap of his interference in the World Title match

caption: Ranked #2 contender for the BSWF World Championship on the fed's own Rankings page; turned the title match at Monday Mayhem by running in on Merchandi$e's behalf, drilling The Clark with his own "Clark Bottom" and locking on the "TECHsas maple leaf."

name: Kadafi

tenures.source: the fed's own served Thursday Night Thump-Fest broadcast — BSWF Tag Team Championship challenger alongside Scarface

caption: Teamed with Scarface to challenge the Made Men for the BSWF Tag Team Championship at Thursday Night Thump-Fest, pedigreeing Mi$ta for what should have been the pinfall before the referee was pulled from the ring.

name: Scarface

tenures.source: the fed's own served Thursday Night Thump-Fest broadcast — BSWF Tag Team Championship challenger alongside Kadafi

caption: Teamed with Kadafi to challenge the Made Men for the BSWF Tag Team Championship at Thursday Night Thump-Fest, a match the referee never got to finish.

name: Castro

tenures.source: the fed's own served Thursday Night Thump-Fest broadcast — ran in with Ceesalo to break up a Tag Title-match beatdown
